description: This Java class 'RetrieveFeaturesStrategy' implements a strategy for handling 'RetrieveFeatures' commands within a persistence layer, extracting features from 'Thing' objects, generating JSON responses, and managing entity tags.

classes.name: RetrieveFeaturesStrategy
classes.description: A final class implementing a command strategy to retrieve features from a 'Thing' and generate appropriate results, including handling entity tags and JSON serialization.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the strategy to retrieve features from a 'Thing', constructs a response, and returns a result, handling errors if features are not found.

methods.name: extractFeatures
methods.description: Extracts the 'Features' object from a 'Thing', throwing an exception if not present.

methods.name: getFeaturesJson
methods.description: Converts 'Features' to JSON, optionally filtering by selected fields and schema version.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Returns the previous entity tag for a given 'Thing' and command, delegating to 'nextEntityTag'.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Generates the next entity tag from a 'Thing' based on its features.
